push.label: Source change
inventions: Identify one small additive capability that would make the changed area easier to verify.
Propose a compatibility-preserving interface or adapter for the changed area.
Derive a regression test that protects the source lineage and existing behavior.

pull_request.label: Integration proposal
inventions: Propose an alternative implementation that reduces coupling without replacing existing foundations.
Identify a missing contract test, boundary test, or rollback note.
Draft an adversarial review question for provenance, authorization, and failure handling.

schedule.label: Hourly invention pulse
inventions: Propose the next smallest independently reviewable infrastructure improvement.
Identify one unresolved interface that could be made provider-neutral.
Suggest a measurable acceptance test before any implementation is authorized.

workflow_run.label: Validation outcome
inventions: For failures: propose a minimal reproduction, root-cause investigation, and non-mutating repair plan.
For successes: propose a regression test that would detect a nearby failure mode.
Identify whether the workflow outcome should block, warn, or merely inform a human reviewer.

workflow_dispatch.label: Human-seeded invention session
inventions: Generate a bounded architecture experiment with an explicit hypothesis and falsifiable outcome.
Compare a minimal design with a more modular alternative.
Write a review checklist before proposing implementation.
